title: Send a WhatsApp reminder
summary: More actions → Send reminder: approved template for birthday, appointment reminder or invoice due date.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Open their record
steps.details: Tap the patient in the list. The guide continues once their record is open.

steps.title: Send reminder
steps.details: Requires WhatsApp connected at the clinic.

steps.title: Template
steps.details: Birthday, appointment reminder (you choose the appointment) or invoice coming due (you choose the invoice).

steps.title: Send
steps.details: Sent as soon as you tap it and stays in the communication history.
